_readme: Deals page data (rendered by shared/js/deals.js). To mark something as booked, change its "status" from "available" to "sold" (per deal, or per option for deals that have "options"). A deal whose pickup date has passed is hidden automatically. A deal with options shows "Sold out" once every option is sold. Prices are final totals in CLP, calculated from pricing.json V7. Do not show percentages.

en.title: A long week from Puerto Varas
en.camper: Nomads L · sleeps up to 4 · unlimited mileage
en.text: Eight days in northern Patagonia in the roomiest camper of our fleet: the volcanoes and lakes of Los Lagos, Hornopirén, Chaitén and Pumalín Park. Perfect for a family or two couples.
en.wa_what: Nomads L, round trip from Puerto Varas

es.title: Una semana larga desde Puerto Varas
es.camper: Nomads L · hasta 4 personas · kilometraje ilimitado
es.route: Retiro y entrega en Puerto Varas
es.text: Ocho días para recorrer la Patagonia norte con la camper más amplia de la flota: volcanes y lagos de Los Lagos, Hornopirén, Chaitén y el Parque Pumalín. Ideal para una familia o dos parejas.
es.wa_what: Nomads L, retiro y entrega en Puerto Varas

en.title: Pick your dates
en.text: Early summer on the Carretera Austral, before peak season: long days and quiet roads. With 18 or 20 days you can reach Coyhaique, Cerro Castillo and the Marble Caves and still drive back at an easy pace.
en.note: Options close as they get booked.

es.title: Elige tus fechas
es.route: Retiro y entrega en Puerto Varas
es.text: El comienzo del verano en la Carretera Austral, antes de la temporada alta: días largos y caminos tranquilos. Con 18 o 20 días alcanzas a llegar hasta Coyhaique, Cerro Castillo y las Capillas de Mármol, y volver con calma.
es.note: Las opciones se van cerrando a medida que se reservan.
